'''2017 European Championship Day 3 Jonas Hagen Nørregaard LS Rebel Strike Team''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonas Hagen Nørregaard]] at [[2017 European Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jonas Hagen Nørregaard]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open RST Norregaard LS 2017 EC 2.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-european-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125014231/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-european-championships/ Internet Archive]
